evidence.note: GENCLUSTER is a scalable test-time-compute pipeline (parallel generation, behavioral clustering by execution output, LLM-tournament ranking, round-robin submission) that lets an open-weight model (gpt-oss-120b) achieve gold-medal-level performance at the International Olympiad in Informatics 2025 for the first time, by generating up to 5,000 candidate solutions per subtask.
evidence.title: Scaling Test-Time Compute to Achieve IOI Gold Medal with Open-Weight Models

name: GENCLUSTER (parallel generation + behavioral clustering + tournament ranking + round-robin submission)
